policyDocuments.title: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (Rooftop Solar Subsidy Guidelines 2025)
policyDocuments.authority: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy (MNRE), Government of India
policyDocuments.extractedContent:
MINISTRY OF NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY
NOTIFICATION: PM SURYA GHAR: MUFT BIJLI YOJANA
Document Ref: MNRE/RTS/2025/08-B.
Date of Issuance: 15th February 2025.
1. Objectives: To provide free electricity up to 300 units per month to 1 crore households across India through grid-connected residential rooftop solar plants.
2. Central Financial Assistance (CFA):
- For systems up to 2 kW capacity: ₹30,000 per kW (Max ₹60,000).
- For additional capacity beyond 2 kW up to 3 kW: ₹18,000 per kW (Total max ₹78,000 for 3 kW).
- For systems above 3 kW: Cap set at ₹78,000 subsidy.
3. Eligibility:
- The applicant must be an Indian citizen possessing legal residential property with roof rights.
- Valid electricity meter connection in applicant's or spouse's name with zero outstanding dues.
- Commercial or industrial connections are strictly non-eligible under this residential window.
4. Mandatory Required Documents:
- Electricity bill of past 3 months.
- Identity proof (Aadhaar Card mandatory).
- Bank passbook/cancelled cheque with linked Aadhaar.
- Rooftop photographs with unobstructed sun exposure.
5. Application Mechanism:
- Online registration via the National Portal (pmsuryaghar.gov.in).
- Technical feasibility approval from local DISCOM within 15 working days.
- Installation by empaneled vendor within 60 days of sanction.
- Inspection & net-metering commissioning followed by direct DBT subsidy transfer into bank account within 30 days.
6. Penalties & Restrictions:
- Unauthorized modifications or unauthorized diversion of solar power attracts discom disconnection and recovery of subsidy under the Electricity Act 2003.

policyDocuments.title: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act — Citizen Rights & Fiduciary Obligations
policyDocuments.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
policyDocuments.extractedContent:
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA - MINISTRY OF ELECTRONICS & IT
DIRECTIVE ON CITIZEN DATA RIGHTS AND GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL UNDER DPDP ACT.
Notice: MEITY/DPDP/REG-2025/04.
Key Provisions:
1. Citizen Rights:
- Right to access summary of personal data being processed.
- Right to correction, completion, and updating of personal data.
- Right to erasure where retention is no longer necessary.
- Right to nominate a representative in event of death or incapacity.
- Right of grievance redressal within 7 working days from data fiduciary.
2. Consent Architecture:
- Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous with clear affirmative action.
- Multilingual consent notices must be provided in all 22 Eighth Schedule languages.
3. Penalties:
- Data breaches failing to notify Data Protection Board of India (DPBI): Up to ₹250 crore penalty.
- Negligence in safeguarding children's data: Up to ₹200 crore.

policyDocuments.extractedContent:
MINISTRY OF HOUSING AND URBAN AFFAIRS
URBAN CLEAN AIR & PUBLIC MOBILITY MISSION 2025.
Incentives for municipal authorities and citizen charging infrastructure.
- 50% capital subsidy on community EV charging setups in housing societies.
- Priority lane reservations and congestion fee waivers for electric fleet.
- Municipal grievance timeline: Road pothole reports on transit corridors must be resolved within 48 hours under penalty.

policyDocuments.title: Right to Public Services & Digital Delivery Guarantee Directive
policyDocuments.authority: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)
policyDocuments.extractedContent:
DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE REFORMS AND PUBLIC GRIEVANCES
MANDATORY CITIZEN CHARTER & TIMELINES.
1. Citizen Grievance Timelines:
- Potholes and hazardous road conditions: 72 hours max resolution.
- Streetlight repair in municipal zones: 24 to 48 hours.
- Contaminated drinking water leakages: 12 hours emergency response.
2. Escalation & Accountability:
- Automatic escalation to District Collector / Municipal Commissioner upon SLA breach.
- Compensatory token credit for citizen if timeline breached without documented force majeure.

policyExplanations.simpleExplanation: The PM Surya Ghar scheme helps regular families install solar panels on their roofs with government paying up to ₹78,000 of the cost directly into their bank account, giving them up to 300 free electricity units each month.
keyPointsSummary: Government subsidy covers ₹30,000/kW up to 2 kW, and ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW (maximum ₹78,000 subsidy).
Available only for residential households; commercial and factory roofs are strictly excluded.
Electricity bill and Aadhaar card must be in the applicant's or spouse's name.
Subsidy is paid directly into the citizen's bank account (DBT) within 30 days of net-meter commissioning.

eligible: Indian citizens who own a residential house with suitable roof rights.
Active domestic electricity connection with zero unpaid electricity bills.
Bank account linked with Aadhaar card.
ineligible: Commercial shops, industrial units, and agricultural tube-well meters.
Tenants without official written roof authorization from legal owner.

requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card (Identity proof)
Latest 3 months electricity bills
Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque showing IFSC
Clear photograph of rooftop space

applicationGuide.title: Register on National Portal
applicationGuide.description: Visit pmsuryaghar.gov.in, select your State, electricity distribution company (DISCOM), and enter your consumer number.

applicationGuide.title: Apply for Feasibility Approval
applicationGuide.description: Submit your rooftop dimensions and requested capacity. DISCOM approves feasibility within 15 working days.

applicationGuide.title: Vendor Installation
applicationGuide.description: Choose any empaneled solar vendor from the portal list to install the panels and inverter.

applicationGuide.title: Net Meter Commissioning & DBT
applicationGuide.description: DISCOM inspects the plant, installs the bidirectional net meter, and the subsidy gets deposited into your bank account within 30 days.

rights: Right to receive technical feasibility status within 15 working days.
Right to choose any verified vendor from the national registry.
Right to receive DBT subsidy directly without middleman cuts.
responsibilities: Keep solar panels clean and maintain rooftop structural safety.
Do not tamper with net meters or divert generated power to commercial lines.

importantDeadlines.date: Within 30 days of net meter commissioning certificate

faqs.question: What if I already have an off-grid solar inverter at home?
faqs.answer: The PM Surya Ghar subsidy specifically applies to grid-connected net-metered systems. You can upgrade your setup to grid-tied with an empaneled vendor to qualify.

faqs.question: Can housing society apartments apply jointly?
faqs.answer: Yes! Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) can apply for common services (lifts, water pumps, corridor lighting) with up to ₹18,000/kW subsidy capped at 500 kW.

policyExplanations.realWorldImpact: A typical family with a 3 kW system saves approximately ₹2,500 to ₹3,800 on monthly power bills, recovering their private investment share in about 3.5 years while curbing carbon footprint.

citations.explicitStatement: Up to 2 kW capacity: ₹30,000 per kW. For 3 kW: ₹78,000 maximum subsidy cap.
citations.aiInterpretation: A homeowner putting up a 2.5 kW system will receive ₹60,000 + ₹9,000 = ₹69,000 in DBT subsidy.

citations.explicitStatement: Commercial or industrial connections are strictly non-eligible under this residential window.
citations.aiInterpretation: Mixed residential-commercial buildings may require an exclusive domestic sub-meter to qualify.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.description: Provides upfront direct subsidy up to ₹78,000 to residential households for installing rooftop solar panels, granting up to 300 units of free power each month.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: Indian residential homeowners with valid domestic electricity connection and clear roof rights.
benefits: Direct subsidy up to ₹78,000 transferred via DBT
Up to 300 units free solar electricity every month
Concessional low-interest collateral-free bank loans (approx. 7% rate)
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of electricity meter holder
Past 3 months electricity bill
Cancelled cheque / Bank passbook
Rooftop ownership document or house tax receipt
applicationSteps: Register at pmsuryaghar.gov.in
Submit consumer number and Discom details
Receive technical approval and pick registered vendor
Net meter install and DBT subsidy credit
schemes.source: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat — Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.description: World's largest government health assurance scheme providing health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: Low-income households identified in SECC 2011 data, plus all senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of family income.
benefits: Over 27,000 empaneled public and private hospitals across India
Covers up to 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization diagnostic costs
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card or PM-JAY letter
Ration Card / Family identity proof
Active mobile number
applicationSteps: Check eligibility at beneficiary.nha.gov.in
Perform e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or biometric scan
Download instant Ayushman Golden Card
Present card at any empaneled hospital helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra)

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
schemes.description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up greenfield enterprises.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: Women entrepreneurs of any caste/community and SC/ST individuals aged 18+ launching first-time business ventures.
benefits: Composite bank loans ranging from ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore
Comprehensive handholding support from SIDBI and NABARD
requiredDocuments: Identity & Address proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID)
Caste certificate (for SC/ST applicants)
Project report / Business proposal with financial projections
Proof of enterprise premises (rent agreement or deed)
applicationSteps: Register at standupmitra.in
Prepare Detailed Project Report (DPR)
Connect with assigned Lead District Manager bank branch
Sanction and disbursal with credit guarantee coverage
schemes.source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of all landholding farmer families.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: All landholding farmer families who have cultivable landholding in their names.
benefits: Paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months
Direct Bank Transfer without administrative leakage
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card with linked mobile phone
Land ownership record (Khatauni / 7/12 extract / Patta)
Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
applicationSteps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and click New Farmer Registration
Enter Aadhaar number and land record identification
Complete face-auth or OTP-based e-KYC
Verification by District Agriculture Officer
schemes.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS-2)
schemes.description: Encourages industries to hire fresh youth, ITI, diploma, and degree holders by co-sharing stipends with up to ₹1,500/month government stipend support.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: Youth aged 14+ (18+ for hazardous trades) with minimum 5th to graduate qualification looking for vocational industry training.
benefits: Direct monthly stipend reimbursement up to ₹1,500 from Government
Real industry on-the-job training in formal corporate sector
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card
Educational marksheet (10th, 12th, ITI, Diploma or Degree)
Bank passbook details for stipend DBT
applicationSteps: Create Candidate Profile on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
Search apprenticeship vacancies by sector and location
Apply online to prospective companies
Sign digital apprenticeship contract

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana — Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.description: Assists 1 crore urban poor and middle-class families to construct, purchase or rent an affordable pucca house with interest subsidy and direct financial aid.
schemes.eligibilitySummary: Families belonging to EWS (income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (up to ₹6 lakh), and MIG (up to ₹9 lakh) who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
benefits: Interest subsidy of 4.0% on home loans up to ₹25 lakh for 12-year tenure (subsidy benefit up to ₹1.80 lakh)
Direct financial assistance of ₹2.50 lakh for Beneficiary-Led Construction
Affordable rental housing voucher assistance for urban migrant workers
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card for all family members
Income certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Affidavit declaring family owns no pucca house in India
Bank account details and land registry documents (for self-construction)
applicationSteps: Apply via pmay-urban.gov.in or Common Service Centre (CSC)
Select applicable vertical (Credit Linked Subsidy or Construction)
Municipal inspection and socio-economic validation
Subsidy credited to loan account or DBT stages
schemes.source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

factChecks.originalClaim: Viral WhatsApp Message: "Govt of India is giving free ₹5,000 monthly cash allowance to all youth under the PM Berojgari Bhatta Yojana 2025. Click this bit.ly link to claim immediately."
extractedClaims: Central Government has announced a universal ₹5,000 monthly cash allowance for all youth.
Scheme name is PM Berojgari Bhatta Yojana 2025.
factChecks.analysis: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check unit and Ministry of Labour & Employment have officially confirmed that NO such scheme named "PM Berojgari Bhatta Yojana" offering ₹5,000 cash has been launched by the Central Government. The circular circulating on WhatsApp and social media is a phishing scam aimed at harvesting citizens' bank credentials and Aadhaar numbers.
evidenceFound: PIB Fact Check official clarification issued via X (Twitter) refuting the claim.
Official National Career Service portal (ncs.gov.in) has no record of such financial allowance.
Phishing domain registered on anonymous registrar without government NIC/GOV domain extension.
contradictoryEvidence: No official cabinet approval, budget allocation, or gazette notification exists for this allowance.
Government websites exclusively use .gov.in or .nic.in domain extensions.

officialSources.title: PIB Fact Check Official Clarification (Press Information Bureau)
officialSources.authority: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting

officialSources.title: National Career Service Portal — Official Employment Guidelines

factChecks.syntheticMediaNotice: Forensic synthetic media detection is not active. Textual claim verified against authorized Government Gazette records and PIB Fact Check bulletins.

factChecks.originalClaim: Claim on social media: "Citizens aged 70 years and above are now eligible for Ayushman Bharat health insurance regardless of their family income or socio-economic status."
extractedClaims: All citizens aged 70 and above qualify for Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY.
The benefit applies irrespective of socio-economic status or income bracket.
factChecks.analysis: The Union Cabinet officially approved the expansion of Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) to provide health coverage to ALL senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of their income. Eligible seniors receive a distinct Ayushman card providing ₹5 lakh shared/individual coverage per year.
evidenceFound: Cabinet decision officially notified by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
National Health Authority portal beneficiary.nha.gov.in updated with dedicated 70+ registration module.
Over 30 lakh senior citizen cards issued in first phase rollout.

officialSources.title: AB PM-JAY Expansion for Senior Citizens 70+ Notification
officialSources.authority: National Health Authority & Ministry of Health

factChecks.syntheticMediaNotice: Standard factual assertion corroborated directly with Cabinet communique.

factChecks.originalClaim: Viral Facebook Video: "Government has made biometric iris scanning mandatory at all municipal toll plazas starting March 2025, or vehicles will be impounded."
extractedClaims: Iris scanning is mandatory at municipal toll plazas.
Unscanned vehicles face immediate impoundment starting March 2025.
factChecks.analysis: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is piloting GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) based barrierless electronic toll collection alongside existing RFID FASTag. There is NO mandate requiring physical iris scanning of passengers, and no impoundment policy exists for lack of iris verification.
evidenceFound: NHAI policy documents confirm GNSS satellite tolling pilot on selected national highway stretches.
FASTag remains valid and operational across all national toll plazas.
contradictoryEvidence: No Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) circular references vehicle impoundment for iris scanning.

officialSources.title: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways Press Release on GNSS Tolling
officialSources.authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

factChecks.syntheticMediaNotice: Video audio track contains hyperbolic voiceover misrepresenting a technical satellite tolling pilot.
